settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage app preferences, note templates, imports, exports, and data operations.

general.title: General
general.description: Set app-wide list display preferences for note cards, including text truncation and how many fields appear before opening a note.

noteTemplates.title: Note templates
noteTemplates.description: Create and organize note templates, then open a template to manage its nested fields and field settings.

noteLabels.title: Note labels
noteLabels.description: Create reusable shared or note-template-specific labels for organizing your notes.

exportImport.title: Export / Import
exportImport.description: Move data in and out of NoteStack with JSON backups or XLSX imports while keeping existing notes intact.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Check for NoteStack updates, download new versions, and install them when they are ready.

synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.description: Connect one private cloud workspace, review its status, and recover changes that need your attention.

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.description: Manage actions that affect your saved notes, including clearing your note collection.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Enable local troubleshooting tools for this NoteStack installation.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Add, edit, reorder, and control where each note field appears.

general.title: Display preferences
general.description: Control how note cards summarize values in the list.

exportImport.title: Export / Import
exportImport.description: Move your notes data in and out as JSON, or append notes from an XLSX worksheet.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Destructive actions stay guarded behind confirmation.

updater.title: Updates
updater.description: Check for newer app versions and install them when they are ready.

noteTypes.title: Templates
noteTypes.description: Create, rename, delete, and open templates to manage their fields.

developer.title: Developer options
developer.description: Control access to local tools used for troubleshooting NoteStack.

disconnect.title: Disconnect cloud account?
disconnect.description: This removes the local account credentials and binding. Local notes stay on this device and cloud data is not deleted.

repair.title: Repair synchronization?
repair.description: NoteStack will verify the bound workspace and rebuild its change cursor. Local data is preserved.

reset.title: Reset synchronization?
reset.description: A verified backup is created, then local synchronization metadata and pending synchronization work are cleared. Notes stay local.

exportImport.summary: Download a full JSON backup or import data from a JSON export or an XLSX worksheet. JSON imports can preserve exported note template relationships or target one selected note template. XLSX imports always append notes into the selected target note template and skip unmatched headers.
